# uptimekuma_notification_ntfy (Resource)

ntfy notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_ntfy" "example" {
  name       = "ntfy.sh Notifications"
  topic      = "my_uptime_kuma_notifications"
  priority   = 5
  server_url = "https://ntfy.sh"
  icon       = "https://example.com/icon.png"
  is_active  = true
  is_default = false
}

resource "uptimekuma_notification_ntfy" "high_priority" {
  name       = "ntfy Critical Alerts"
  topic      = "critical_alerts"
  priority   = 1
  server_url = "https://ntfy.sh"
  is_active  = true
  is_default = true
}

# Self hosted ntfy server, authenticated with an access token.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_ntfy" "access_token" {
  name       = "ntfy Self Hosted"
  topic      = "uptime_kuma"
  server_url = "https://ntfy.example.com"

  authentication_method = "accessToken"
  access_token          = var.ntfy_access_token

  priority      = 5
  priority_down = 1
}

# Self hosted ntfy server, authenticated with username and password, using
# custom title and message templates.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_ntfy" "username_password" {
  name       = "ntfy Self Hosted (Basic Auth)"
  topic      = "uptime_kuma"
  server_url = "https://ntfy.example.com"

  authentication_method = "usernamePassword"
  username              = var.ntfy_username
  password              = var.ntfy_password

  use_template   = true
  custom_title   = "{{ name }} is {{ status }}"
  custom_message = "{{ msg }}"
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: access_token_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change the matching *_wo_version whenever a secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_ntfy" "write_only" {
  name       = "ntfy with write-only secret"
  topic      = "uptime_kuma"
  server_url = "https://ntfy.example.com"

  authentication_method   = "accessToken"
  access_token_wo         = var.ntfy_access_token
  access_token_wo_version = "1"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name
- `topic` (String) ntfy topic the notifications are published to.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) ntfy access token, used when `authentication_method` is `accessToken`. Stored in state; use `access_token_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `access_token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) ntfy access token, used when `authentication_method` is `accessToken`, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `access_token`; requires `access_token_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `access_token_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `access_token` until the next apply with `access_token_wo` set removes it from state.
- `access_token_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `access_token_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `access_token_wo`.
- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `authentication_method` (String) Authentication method used to talk to the ntfy server. One of `none`, `usernamePassword` or `accessToken`. Defaults to `none`.
- `call` (String) Phone number to call for every notification, or `yes` to call the account's verified number (ntfy `X-Call` header).
- `custom_message` (String) Custom message template. Only used if `use_template` is `true`.
- `custom_title` (String) Custom title template. Only used if `use_template` is `true`.
- `icon` (String) URL of the icon attached to the notification.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `password` (String, Sensitive) ntfy password, used when `authentication_method` is `usernamePassword`. Stored in state; use `password_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) ntfy password, used when `authentication_method` is `usernamePassword`, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `password`; requires `password_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `password_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `password` until the next apply with `password_wo` set removes it from state.
- `password_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `password_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `password_wo`.
- `priority` (Number) Priority of the notification, between 1 and 5. Used for all notifications and as the basis for the down priority when `priority_down` is not set. Defaults to `5`.
- `priority_down` (Number) Priority of the notification sent when a monitor goes down, between 1 and 5. If not set, Uptime Kuma uses `priority` + 1, capped at 5.
- `server_url` (String) URL of the ntfy server. Defaults to `https://ntfy.sh`.
- `use_template` (Boolean) Use `custom_title` and `custom_message` instead of the default notification title and message.
- `username` (String) ntfy username, used when `authentication_method` is `usernamePassword`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
